title: Rava bar Itai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Shevuot 36b, Rav Acha bar Huna, Rav Shmuel son of Rabbah bar bar Chana and Rav Yitzchak son of Rav Yehudah were studying Shevuot in Rabbah’s school; Rav Kahana met them and asked them. Rava bar Itai said to them: “Who is the Tanna who [holds that] deliberate…,” etc.
In Bava Metzia 14a he said to Rav Idi bar Avin: “Did Shmuel say so?”
In Keritot 24a: “Rabbah bar Itai said that Resh Lakish said.”

notes.text: The supplied ב״ה is supported as bar Huna by saved Davidson Shevuot 36b. The episode begins there; Rava bar Itai’s reply is on 37a in that edition. Current and historical names, including Rabbah in Keritot, are preserved.
